verdict.rationale: Raygun's crash-reporting page says errors can be ordered and prioritized by users affected, not only by occurrence count. That covers the core of prioritizing by user blast radius. The evidence never mentions per-issue counts of affected sessions, and the claim rests on a single marketing statement. Missing for 10: affected-session counts per issue, in-depth docs on how users-affected is calculated and shown, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, every issue quantifies real impact — how many users and sessions are affected — so I prioritize by blast radius, not raw event counts

citations.quote: Order and prioritize errors based on users affected and the number of occurrences
